newsitem.title: UK: BT extends UK residential discount scheme.
newsitem.headline: BT extends UK residential discount scheme.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) said on Wednesday it would extend the scope of its popular Friends & Family discount system for residential UK customers.

In a statement, the company said it would allow customers a guaranteed discount of 10 percent on all calls to a further five nominated numbers, in addition to the five already allowed under the scheme.

Since it revamped the scheme last April, as part of a broad response to the inroads being made in the UK residential market by cable television companies offering telephony services, BT said scheme participants have more than trebled to nine million.
Only one of the specified Friends & Family numbers can be overseas, and one can be a mobile telephone.
